cards.title: Hive Mind
cards.rules: On 3, everyone names a body part. All match, you drink 5. Otherwise the odd ones drink 2.

cards.title: Mind Meld
cards.rules: You and your left neighbor say a word at once until you match. Each miss, both drink 1.

cards.title: Majority Rules
cards.rules: On 3, everyone points up or down. The smaller side drinks 2. A tie, everyone drinks 2.

cards.title: Finger Count
cards.rules: On 3, everyone shows 1 to 6 fingers. Then roll d6.

cards.title: Beer or Liquor
cards.rules: On 3, everyone says beer or liquor. Then flip the coin.

outcomes.instruction: Tails. Everyone who said beer drinks 2.
Heads. Everyone who said liquor drinks 2.

cards.title: Night Bus
cards.rules: Roll to stay on the bus. Cash out and give the pot, or ride on. Bust and drink it.

cards.title: Roulette
cards.rules: One chamber is loaded. Pull the trigger: cash out and give the pot, or go again.

cards.title: Let It Ride
cards.rules: Double or nothing. Flip: cash out and give the pot, or let it ride.

cards.title: Snake Eyes
cards.rules: Roll 2d6 and pray for more than 4. Cash out and give the pot, or roll on.

cards.title: Penny Slots
cards.rules: Pull the lever. Cash out and give the pot, or pull again. Lose and drink it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The machine eats your card. Bust.

cards.title: High Roller
cards.rules: Big table, big pot. Roll: cash out and give it, or go again. Bust and drink it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Security walks you out. Bust.

cards.title: Seven Out
cards.rules: Roll 2d6. Anything but a 7 keeps you shooting. Cash out and give the pot, or roll on.

cards.title: Pyramid
cards.rules: Climb the pyramid one row a roll. Cash out and give the pot, or climb on.

cards.title: Chicken
cards.rules: Roll to keep driving at the wall. Cash out and give the pot, or floor it.

cards.title: Card Counter
cards.rules: Roll 2d6. Doubles and the pit boss spots you. Cash out and give the pot, or keep counting.

cards.title: Beer Run
cards.rules: Run for the store before last call. Cash out and give the pot, or run on.

cards.title: Hot Streak
cards.rules: You can't miss tonight. Roll: cash out and give the pot, or stay hot.

cards.title: Red or Black
cards.rules: Everyone calls red or black. Then flip the coin.

outcomes.instruction: Tails is black. Everyone who called red drinks 2.
Heads is red. Everyone who called black drinks 2.

cards.title: Higher or Lower
cards.rules: Everyone calls high or low. Then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Low. Everyone who called high drinks 2.
High. Everyone who called low drinks 2.

cards.title: Over Under
cards.rules: Everyone calls over or under 7. Then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Under. Everyone who called over drinks 2.
Dead center. Everyone drinks 3. House wins.
Over. Everyone who called under drinks 2.

cards.title: Slot Machine
cards.rules: Pull the lever. Roll 3d6.

cards.title: Boxcars
cards.rules: Roll 2d6 for the table.

cards.title: Free Bet
cards.rules: The house gives you a free bet. Flip the coin.

cards.title: Screw the Dealer
cards.rules: Your left neighbor picks 1 to 6 in secret. Two guesses: miss, drink 3; hit, they drink 3.

cards.title: Pit Boss
cards.rules: Until your next turn, you're the pit boss: anyone who touches their phone drinks 2.

cards.title: Tip Your Dealer
cards.rules: Your left neighbor drinks 2 for the service.

cards.title: Comped
cards.rules: The house likes you. Give 4.

cards.title: Poker Face
cards.rules: Stare down your right neighbor. First to smile drinks 3.

cards.title: All In
cards.rules: Push it all in: finish your drink, then give out 6.

cards.title: Whale
cards.rules: Whoever has spent the most money tonight drinks 3. Money talks.

cards.title: House Always Wins
cards.rules: Everyone drinks 2. The house always wins.

cards.title: Bad Beat
cards.rules: Tell the table your worst luck story. Everyone drinks 1 in sympathy.

cards.title: Counting Cards
cards.rules: The table counts to 20, one number each, no order. Two say a number at once: both drink 2.

cards.title: Ace Up the Sleeve
cards.rules: Until your next turn, you may pass one drink you're given to someone else.

cards.title: Dealer's Choice
cards.rules: You deal: everyone drinks 2, or one person of your choice drinks 5.
